job.title: Dentist
job.description:
Dentist – 2- 3 Days Per Week
A modern, welcoming, and community‑minded practice is seeking an experienced Dentist to join its close‑knit team.  This is an opportunity to step into a supportive environment where quality, compassion, and long‑term patient relationships are at the heart of the work.

Why This Role Stands Out
A Restorative‑Focused Book
With preventive care managed by Oral Health Therapists, the incoming dentist will enjoy a predominantly restorative and adult‑focused schedule.  This allows for meaningful, higher‑value clinical work without routine Exam/Scale/Cleans dominating the day.

A Well ‑Supported, Well ‑Organised Environment
The practice is structured so clinicians can focus on what they do best — delivering excellent dentistry.  Systems are smooth, the team is reliable, and support is consistent.  The dentist can step into the day knowing the room is prepared, the schedule is managed, and the team is aligned, allowing them to concentrate fully on their skills and patient care.

A Thriving, Beautiful Location
Situated in the Adelaide Hills and just 35 minutes from the CBD, the area is one of the fastest‑growing and most sought‑after regions.  It offers the perfect blend of lifestyle, community, and convenience — ideal for clinicians who enjoy working in a peaceful, scenic setting while staying connected to the city.

A Loyal, Diverse Patient Base
The practice supports a broad mix of patients — families, adults prioritising restorative and aesthetic care, and many returning to dentistry after time away.  Patients value a calm, gentle approach and appreciate clinicians who take the time to build trust.

A Collaborative, Growth ‑Minded Team
The environment is warm, steady, and team‑oriented.  Clinicians share knowledge freely, support one another, and work together to deliver ethical, high‑quality dentistry.  The practice values continuous learning and welcomes dentists who enjoy refining their skills and contributing to a positive, community‑focused culture.

What You’ll Be Doing
A broad mix of general and restorative dentistry, including:
  • Restorative treatment
  • Crowns, veneers, and cosmetic dentistry
  • Root canal therapy
  • Extractions
  • Fillings
  • Implant restoration or placement (depending on experience)
Who Will Thrive Here
This role suits a dentist who:
  • Has at least two years of experience
  • Enjoys building long‑term patient relationships
  • Works calmly and confidently with adults, families, and anxious patients
  • Values autonomy, ethical care, and unrushed appointments
  • Appreciates a supportive, well‑organised team
  • Is warm, approachable, and committed to high‑quality dentistry
Days: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday (with optional additional Saturdays).
Hours: 9am–5pm, with flexibility for a late night if desired.
Next Steps
For a dentist who thrives in a warm, organised, and restorative‑focused environment, this role offers the ideal balance of autonomy, support, and meaningful patient care. 

Apply here or for a confidential discussion about the role and your needs, please call Lyn 0488 841560 or email jobs@lyncdental.com.au

job.title: Dental Hygienist
job.description:
Dental Hygienist | Part-Time

Some hygiene rooms are a production line.  This one isn't.

It's a calm, comfort-led practice - the kind that thinks about the nervous patient before they're even in the chair.  Every patient gets a full hour.  There's an assistant beside you - setting up, turning the room over, and floating in to support through the appointment - so your attention stays where it needs to be, on the person in the chair.  Recalls are flexible, and care is planned around what people need rather than what the clock allows.
It's the kind of room where you can do the work properly.  Educate.  Take your time.  Build something with the patients who come back to you regularly.
You'd work four days, daytime hours, with an experienced clinical team around you and a genuine path for someone earlier in their career to grow.  The scope is broad and full - if you want to use everything you trained for, you'll get to.

What's in it for you
  • A full hour with every patient
  • An assistant who sets up, turns over the room, and floats in to support you
  • Work to full scope, with the equipment and support to back it
  • Paid CPD, training, and bonuses — they back your growth, not just your output
  • Flexible recalls — care planned around the patient
  • Steady daytime hours, four days a week
  • Room to grow if you're newer, real autonomy if you're not
  • $60–$80 per hour, depending on experience
Who it's for
A hygienist who's gentle, thorough, and easy for patients to trust — good with the nervous ones, the kids, the regulars.  Someone who likes teaching people about their own mouth and health, and watching it click.  More than 1 year of experience is ideal, but a confident new graduate who's ready to back themselves and be mentored is just as welcome.

The quiet part
Lync is handling the hiring for this Premium practice — one that invests in its team and how it's looked after.  The nice part:  you can have a confidential chat first, share what you're looking for, and work out whether it's a fit — before anyone knows who you are.  No pressure either way.

If this sounds like the kind of room you've been looking for, reach out or apply.
Lyn -  0488 841560  jobs@lyncdental.com.au

This practice is growing and evolving, and they're looking for a Lead DA who brings more than clinical skill.  Someone with the emotional intelligence to read a room, the confidence to lead from the front, and the desire to help a capable team do its best work together.

Working chairside across the dentist and hygiene/OHT team, the Lead DA will keep communication clear, the day running smoothly, and every patient well looked after.
The clinical team is experienced and knows what good looks like.  The support team is earlier in their careers — eager, willing and ready to learn from someone who knows their craft and leads with generosity.  This is a role for someone who finds that combination energising.
  • Work chairside across the dentist and hygiene/OHT clinicians

This family‑focused practice blends modern dentistry with a broader wellness mindset.  The atmosphere is relaxed, friendly, and grounded in teamwork.  With an on-site laboratory supported by prosthetists and technicians, clinicians benefit from streamlined workflows, high‑quality prosthetics, and the ability to collaborate closely on complex cases.

Joining a Supportive Team as a Front Office Coordinator

For the experienced and passionate dental professional who has been searching for a place where their contributions are genuinely valued and respected, this is the opportunity to become a Lead Dental Receptionist.  This team is looking for a fantastic individual to join their team, offering a pathway to professional development and a stable, positive environment where they can be the reliable, welcoming leader of the front office, supporting patients and clinicians with both organisational skill and genuine warmth, and being fully supported in return. About the Role and Your Contributions
As the Lead Front Office Co-ordinator, you will be crucial to the smooth daily operation of this busy preventive dental practice.  Your time will be spent coordinating a full and fulfilling practice schedule and enriching the lives of both patients and colleagues.  Your main tasks will include:
  • Leading the front office team with a steady, confident, and welcoming approach.
  • Managing the appointment book expertly, processing payments, and following established systems for cancellations, inquiries, and emergencies.
  • Handling essential administrative duties like producing monthly reports, managing supplies, and general correspondence.
  • Ensuring accuracy in managing patient treatment plans, bookings, and financial processes.
  • Daily use and management of EXACT software is a key part of this role.
Who They Are Looking For
The team is seeking a mature, stable, and emotionally intelligent individual who genuinely enjoys their work, is a dedicated team player, and is committed to both personal and professional development.  They desire a wholesome and well-rounded professional who:
  • Consistently demonstrates emotional intelligence and stability, maintaining a positive and focused presence that contributes to the team’s supportive professional atmosphere.
  • Is warm, competent, and welcoming, providing a reassuring presence for all.
  • Understands the business aspect of running a busy practice, recognising the importance of a full schedule and maintaining patient relationships.
  • Is proactive and has a growth mindset, looking for opportunities to improve office systems for the benefit of the patients, the team, and the business.
  • Shows genuine empathy to every patient while communicating clearly and confidently with their loyal patient base.
Working Life and Benefits
This practice is deeply committed to supporting its team members.  You will benefit from:
  • Significant opportunities for development, including training and coaching through Prime Practice and ongoing professional development initiatives.
  • A strong, supportive team culture with regular communication, including daily huddles and frequent team meetings.
  • Access to external support, including an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and external coaching resources.
  • A healthy work environment with consistent hours: full-time (5 days, Monday–Friday), with 8:00/8:30 AM starts and finishing by 5:30 PM.
  • A provided professional uniform and additional perks like team lunches and social events.
They are offering a remuneration range of $30–$40 per hour, based on experience and the unique qualities you bring.  They are flexible for the right candidate and open to discussing additional benefits, such as salary sacrifice or extra annual leave. Ready to Make a Difference?
If you are ready to bring your mature, supportive talent to a practice that truly values its team and keeps patient care at the centre of everything they do, we would be eager to hear from you.  This team is genuinely looking forward to finding the right person and warmly welcoming them into their growing professional family.   Apply here with a cover letter sharing why this role would be a good fit for you. For a confidential discussion to share your needs and explore further, call Lyn 0417874996 or email jobs@lyncdental.com.au

job.title: Dental Assistant
job.description:
Join a Beautiful Beachside Dental Practice

Due to practice expansion, a beautiful beachside dental practice is seeking its next superstar assistant to join the team.  This is a chance to work in a busy, modern 6-chair practice that offers a diverse range of services, from routine hygiene to specialised oral surgery and orthodontics.

The Position
This is a permanent part-time position that will be a mix of chairside assisting and steri duties.  The successful candidate will play a vital role in ensuring a seamless and efficient workflow for a dedicated team.
While the practice is seeking an experienced Dental Assistant who can hit the ground running, it is also open to providing a traineeship for the right candidate who demonstrates a strong passion for dental care and a commitment to learning.

What the Practice is Looking For
The ideal candidate is flexible and caring, with a positive, happy personality.  They should be able to think on their feet, be a great team player, and keep busy during any downtime.
•    Experience with Cerec, orthodontics, and oral surgery is highly regarded.
•    A Radiography certificate is a significant advantage.
•    The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and contribute to a collaborative team culture is essential.

The Practice's Employee Value Proposition (EVP)
The practice is committed to the growth and well-being of its team members.  It provides a supportive environment where staff can thrive, with opportunities for upskilling and development.  The practice is happy to cover the costs of training and certificates, such as Radiography or Cert IV, to help assistants expand their skills.  This team is like a family, and they celebrate successes with regular staff outings and a happy, collaborative culture.
The practice is dedicated to clinical excellence, utilising state-of-the-art technology, including Cerec and sedation, to provide the highest standard of care to its patients.  It offers a modern and professional work environment where team members can be proud of the work they do every day.

How to Apply
If you are the ideal assistant this team is looking for, please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and why you are an excellent fit for this team.  We are excited to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion to learn more, please call 0417 874996 or email jobs@lyncdental.com.au.

job.title: Dental Receptionist
job.description:
Dental Receptionist - Front Office Lead About the Role

This boutique dental practice is seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Front Office Lead to join their small, happy team.  This is a chance to be the first welcoming face for patients and the heart of the practice, providing a level of care that goes beyond the ordinary.  This team delivers a full spectrum of dental services, from general and preventative care to cosmetic and complex surgical procedures.

This is a full-time position for a reliable, organised, and friendly individual.  The successful person will work a varied schedule with patients booked:

  • Monday - Wednesday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

  • Thursday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM

  • Friday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM (with two full days a month until 5:00 PM on surgical days)

The practice works as a cohesive team and is looking for someone with dental experience who can seamlessly handle front desk duties while being happy and willing to relieve as a dental assistant occasionally.   This practice is growing and searching for a natural leader who can take ownership of the front office, supporting the growth and vision of the principal dentist.

What the Role Entails

As the ‘warm welcome’ at the front desk, you'll be the cornerstone of a smooth patient experience.  Your duties will include:

  • Providing outstanding customer service with excellent phone etiquette.

  • Managing the appointment book with precision to ensure a productive schedule.

  • Handling patient bookings, payments, and end-of-day reconciliation.

  • Data entry, reporting, and preparing information for payroll and recalls.

  • Building lasting relationships with patients by making them feel comfortable and valued.

  • Helping in steri and supporting practitioners, when needed.

This is a pivotal role that also offers the opportunity to participate in practice management tasks, including supporting the principal with key performance indicators (KPIs), assisting with commission calculations and invoicing, and contributing to the overall growth and success of the practice.

The practice believes in a holistic approach to dental health, focusing on comprehensive care and building long-term relationships with its patients.  You'll be part of a team that's proud of its preventative care results and the personal connections it creates.  This is a place where genuine care for every individual patient matters, and the team goes above and beyond to help them on their journey to oral health, whether it’s for general dental care, teeth whitening, or more advanced procedures like implants and facial cosmetic treatments.

Qualities the Practice is Seeking

The ideal person is a cheerful and energetic individual who is organised and stays on task.  This team needs someone who thrives on managing the many roles of the front office, multitasking and feeling in control of their front office area with pride,  and who is always ready to learn and grow.  The ideal candidate will be:

  • Professional, pleasant, and friendly.

  • A professional and pleasant leader who thrives in a dynamic setting.

  • Attentive to detail and able to follow directions.

  • A true team member who is happy to support colleagues and be supported.

  • Easy-going and polite in all communications.

What the Practice Offers
  • Remuneration:  A fair and relevant hourly rate, based on experience and negotiation.

  • Professional Development: The practice is dedicated to your growth.  They offer paid training and support for your personal development plan, including dedicated training on Principle software, and a dedicated front desk coach.

  • Bonuses: High performers are rewarded for their dedication.

  • Uniforms: A provided uniform makes getting ready for work a breeze.

The practice's mission is to create a safe, comfortable place where everyone can get the best dental health care.  Their values are built on genuine care, teamwork, integrity, and respect.  If you're ready to join a supportive, boutique practice where they know and care for their patients individually, we encourage you to apply.  Please provide a cover letter responding to this role and your up-to-date resume, which demonstrates your relevant dental experience.  

For a confidential discussion, call 0417874996 or email jobs@lyncdental.com.au

job.title: Dental Hygienist
job.description:
Dental Hygienist Join a Caring and Innovative Practice & Shape Your Career

Ready to build something extraordinary?  Imagine being the driving force behind a brand-new hygiene department in a thriving, well-established dental practice just 90 minutes from Melbourne CBD.   This isn't simply a job; it's a chance to shape the future of patient care, working alongside a respected team and making a real impact from day one.   If you're a skilled and passionate Dental Hygienist seeking a career-defining opportunity, this is it.

What's In It for You?  Balanced Work Week—Enjoy a consistent schedule working Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Significant Growth Potential—This newly created role offers exciting potential for expansion as the hygiene department flourishes.   The practice focuses on a wide range of dental services, so you'll have the opportunity to develop your clinical skills and collaborate with experienced clinicians.

Supportive and Caring Team Environment—Benefit from the support of dedicated dental assistants who handle setup, room turnover, and sterilisation, allowing you to focus on providing exceptional patient care.    Be part of a friendly and collaborative team dedicated to patient comfort.

State-of-the-Art Technology—The practice uses advanced equipment, including Piezo and Cavitron ultrasonic scalers, AirFlow, and hand instruments, to deliver the highest-quality care.  It is committed to staying at the forefront of dental technology.

Professional Development—The practice values continuous learning and encourages you to expand your knowledge and expertise in a collaborative setting.  Working alongside experienced clinicians with special interests in Orthodontics and Implants will provide invaluable growth opportunities.

Uniform Allowance—Maintain a polished and professional image with a provided uniform allowance.

A Day in Your New Role

✔️Provide comprehensive hygiene care tailored to various patient needs, from new patient assessments and reactivations to ongoing maintenance.

✔️Tailor appointment intervals to individual patient needs (3 or 6 months).

✔️Conduct thorough hygiene examinations, including charting and detailed notes.   Appointment times are flexible, based on clinician needs and the services provided.

✔️Collaborate with senior clinicians on complex cases and engage in discussion.

✔️Assist senior clinicians with scans, pre-op/post-op photographs, and preparation for emergency patients as needed.

✔️Take new patient histories and complete charting.

✔️Deliver specialised care, including periodontal care, implant maintenance, and orthodontic hygiene.

✔️Perform additional procedures such as silver fluoride application, impressions, scanning, and fissure seals.

✔️Assist with administrative tasks as needed during any downtime.

 

Who This Team Are Searching For… The ideal candidate will have:
  • Experience in Orthodontics and Paediatrics, which will be highly regarded.
  • A genuine passion for patient care with a proactive and patient-focused approach.
  • Strong communication skills, adaptability, and a collaborative mindset to integrate seamlessly into a team that values quality care and professional growth.
  • Confidence in contributing to the development of this new department, supporting both the team and patients in embracing the skills and expertise they bring.  This includes educating and guiding colleagues and patients on the benefits of preventative care and effective hygiene practices.
  • A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to expand the scope of hygiene services within the practice.
  • A willingness to share their knowledge and collaborate on developing protocols and best practices to establish the department as an essential part of patient care.
  • This is an incredible opportunity to support a growing team, enjoy variety in your day, and expand your scope of practice in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

Call Lyn on 0417 874 996 for a confidential discussion, or email your cover letter, describing why this is your ideal role, and resume to jobs@lyncdental.com.au

job.title: Hygienist/Oral Health Therapist
job.description:
Opportunity for a Dedicated Dental Hygienist / Oral Health Therapist (1 Day/Week)

A highly skilled, patient-centric Dental Hygienist or Oral Health Therapist is invited to join a reputable dental practice, a one-day-a-week role, every Tuesday. This unique opportunity focuses on advanced care, building genuine patient relationships, and expanding your professional skills across diverse treatments, including OHT scope, if desired.

About the Practice

This specialist practice focuses on Prosthodontics, providing comprehensive full-mouth rehabilitation and All-on-4 treatments.  The team provides high-quality, patient-centred care, treating every patient like a dear family member. Clear protocols and a culture of encouraging team solutions define the practice.

You’ll collaborate with a diverse team including specialists and general dentists, managers, coordinators, treatment consultants, and in-house lab technicians.  Weekly team meetings and morning huddles ensure integrated support and alignment.

The Role

This part-time position is for one day a week, every Tuesday, with patient hours from 8:50 AM to 5:00 PM.  The schedule allocates dedicated time for patient preparation and note completion. Remuneration is $60–$70 per hour.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building strong patient relationships and understanding care motivations.
  • Delivering comprehensive hygiene and periodontal treatments
  • Managing periodontal patients and providing specialised implant care.
  • Taking routine radiographs (Intraoral & OPGs) and conducting periodontal charting.
  • Pre-brief dentists on patient history and treatment needs.
  • Ensuring timely note completion, maintaining schedules, and smooth handovers.
  • Discussing treatment options with patients engagingly.
  • Using advanced dental instruments
  • Operating advanced equipment such as an in-house intra-oral scanner for nightguards and blueprint planning, and a CBCT machine.
  • Assisting with specific procedures, such as dental implant bridge removal, with training.
  • Capturing clinical photographs for complex cases
About You

The ideal candidate naturally connects with patients emotionally, understanding anxieties and empathising with their journey.  They are inherently non-judgmental, kind, empathetic, and a true team player, contributing positively to the practice.  This individual is a proactive problem-solver who takes initiative, meticulously completes tasks, and ensures thorough, timely notes.

The successful candidate is honest and communicates respectfully, consistently delivering on commitments.  They embrace continuous growth, viewing challenges as learning opportunities.  A lifelong learner, this oral health practitioner actively seeks education and is open to new, effective techniques.  They also understand that personal well-being is vital for thriving in their role and providing exceptional care. Sound like you?

The Benefits & What Makes This Role Unique
  • Dedicated Weekly Schedule:  Enjoy consistent Tuesday-only hours for predictable life balance, with potential for more days.
  • Advanced Equipment Access: Work with cutting-edge equipment, including an in-house lab, intra-oral scanner, 3D printer, OPG, and Conebeam, enhancing your clinical capabilities and treatment planning.
  • Specialised Treatment Exposure: Gain unique experience in Prosthodontics, full mouth rehabilitation, and all-on-4 treatments.
  • Structured Professional Growth: Benefit from weekly 1-hour staff trainings and full-day monthly trainings (practice closed) for team development.
  • Supportive Team Environment: Collaborate with a diverse and committed team, prioritising clear protocols and open communication.
  • Streamlined Operations: A dental assistant for setup, turnover, and steri, allowing focus on patient care.
  • Comprehensive Induction: An induction process provides clarity and support.
  • Uniform Provided

This role is more than a ‘job’—it is a chance to contribute to a practice that deeply values its patients and team members.  If you are ready to advance your skills and grow alongside a dedicated team, apply today!

For a confidential discussion to learn more and share your unique needs, please call Lyn 0417874996 or email jobs@lyncdental.com.au
